name: Guizhou BC&TV Information Network CO.,LTD
summary: Guizhou BC&TV Information Network CO.,LTD operates and constructs radio and television networks in China. The company is involved in cable TV network construction; and broadband network, smart radio, radio and television 5G, and cultural tourism and technology businesses. It also provides cable TV programs live audiovisual, program content landing transmission, network installation and daily management and maintenance, broadcasting, radio and television audiovisual, cable television program, and program content transmission services. The company was founded in 2008 and is based in Guiyang, China.
